name: multi-direction-slide-text
title: Multi Direction Slide Text
description: Two lines of text arrive from opposite sides at once: the first slides in from the left, the second from the right, both fading up and meeting in the centre stack.
useWhen: A two-part statement (setup and punchline, before and after) should come together from both sides.
avoidWhen: Only one line of text: use mask-reveal-up or line-by-line-slide.
Both lines should move the same way: use line-by-line-slide.
author: Eldora UI
